title: Story premise EDU094: The Flashlight Asks for a Guest List
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: Why would this button need those contacts? Takeaway/theme: Evaluate a permission request against the feature, data involved, and trusted explanation.
description: A user wants a simple toy app function, but an unexpected permission request reaches unrelated data. A purpose-to-permission map highlights the mismatch and lets the user review the request before deciding.
